description: How code may reach the database (technical-plan Section 3). Feature modules may not import @/db/client at all: they get business data only through forBusiness() in src/db/scope.ts, which filters every query by business. Only databaseFiles may import the database, and of those only platformFiles may import business tables. eslint.config.mjs reads this file; src/db/tenancy.test.ts checks it.

alsoGuarded.businesses: The business row itself. Read and change it through scope.business() and scope.updateBusiness().
alsoGuarded.membershipLocations: Has no business_id; its rows belong to a membership, so it is guarded with memberships.

databaseFilesReason: Accounts, sessions, rate limits, platform admins and plans are not business data. The others are platform files below.
platformFilesReason: These create businesses, decide who is acting in one, resolve plans, write the activity log, read the published parts of business pages for guests, take bookings from guests (who have no membership, and whose chosen professional may be busy at another business), and run the platform administrator's screens. They run before a scope exists, or for every business, so they read business tables directly. Keep this list short.
